On September 18, Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te personally observed a large-scale joint precision-munitions live-fire exercise at the Jiupeng military range.
The Republic of China Navy (ROCN), also known as the Taiwanese Navy, launched a ground-based Hsiung Feng III (HF-3) supersonic anti-ship missile, which struck the decommissioned Lan Yang (FFG-935), used as a target ship to simulate a People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) combat vessel.
The exercise also involved rocket launches from M142 HIMARS and surface-to-air missile launches from Tien Kung III (TK-3), also known as Sky Bow, an anti-ballistic missile (ABM) system.
The drills were intended to practice the joint use of precision weapons against simulated targets representing a PLA amphibious force during a potential operation against Taiwan.
